scripts.set-webhook: if [ -z "$BOT_TOKEN" ]; then echo 'BOT_TOKEN is not set' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -n "$WEBHOOK_SECRET" ]; then curl -sS -X POST "https://api.telegram.org/bot$BOT_TOKEN/setWebhook?url=https://$REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN/bot/webhook&secret_token=$WEBHOOK_SECRET"; else curl -sS -X POST "https://api.telegram.org/bot$BOT_TOKEN/setWebhook?url=https://$REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN/bot/webhook"; fi
